nodes.name: docker-compose.yaml

nodes.name: backend
nodes.summary: Go backend API service built from the local Dockerfile, exposed on port 8088. Configured via environment variables for the Postgres DSN, SeaweedFS file store endpoint/bucket, session secret, and super-admin credentials; waits for the database to be healthy before starting.

nodes.name: database
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL 16 (alpine) service exposing port 5432, with a pg_isready health check and a persistent volume under ./local_storage_data/postgres backing the project_works database.

nodes.name: file_storage
nodes.summary: SeaweedFS service running in S3 mode (server -s3) to provide S3-compatible object storage for attachments, exposing the S3 API (8333), master (9333), and filer web UI (8888) with a persistent data volume.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build that compiles the Go backend in a golang:1.26-alpine builder stage (static CGO-disabled binary from ./cmd/server) and copies the binary and migrations into a minimal alpine:3.20 runtime image exposing port 8088.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: First build stage based on golang:1.26-alpine that downloads modules, tidies dependencies, and compiles the backend into a static linux binary at /build/project-works-server.

nodes.name: alpine
nodes.summary: Final runtime stage based on alpine:3.20 that installs ca-certificates and tzdata, copies the compiled server binary and migrations from the builder stage, exposes port 8088, and runs the server as the entrypoint.

nodes.name: package.yml
nodes.summary: Currently empty GitHub Actions workflow placeholder, presumably reserved for a future packaging or release pipeline.

layers.name: Data Schema & Migrations
layers.description: PostgreSQL schema migrations and the table/schema/endpoint definitions describing the persisted data model and the OpenAPI surface.

layers.name: Infrastructure & CI/CD
layers.description: Docker images, Docker Compose topology (backend, database, file storage), test container, and GitHub Actions packaging/test pipelines.

layers.name: Configuration & Tooling
layers.description: Application config loading, the config.yaml / go.mod project config, and build/dev tooling scripts (justfile, test results parser, entry points).

layers.description: Project documentation: README, ARCHITECTURE, DATA_MODEL, backend DIAGRAM, and Claude guidance.
